system.description:
You have been marked with a special sealing mark created by the Kuru. Kuru refers to the clan of the creature that inflicted this seal.

Once per turn, If a Kuru deals damage to a Yin-Sealed creature, the Kuru regains 1 Foresight.

Attacks a Yin-Sealed creature makes against a Kuru suffer a -2 penalty to their result.

Saving throws a Yin-Sealed creature forces a Kuru to make are treated as if they have a -1 penalty, only for the Kuru.

A creature immune to the Sealed condition is immune to this condition.

A creature can spend its action to make a DC 20 Ninshou check to remove this condition.
system.summary: Its attacks against a Kuru take −2; its saves forced on a Kuru count −1; a Kuru that damages it regains 1 Foresight once per turn.

rules.text: Attacks it makes against a Kuru: −2. Saves it forces a Kuru to make: −1 for the Kuru. Once per turn a Kuru that damages it regains 1 Foresight. Creatures immune to Sealed are immune to this.
